page.overview:
What is Drúadan Forest?

Drúadan Forest, also known as Tawar-in-Drúedain, was a pine forest located in Anórien, which was north of Minas Tirith. The forest was inhabited by a strange folk of Men known as the Drúedain or Wild Men of the Woods.

According to the , the forest was over forty miles in total length. The highest point in the forest was Eilenach, which was the second Warning beacon.

The forest had been occupied by the Drúedain since sometime between or after the years SA 883 and SA 1075. It was known for being avoided by outsiders.

In the Fourth Age, King Elessar declared that the men of the forest would have the land to themselves because of their help during the war.
